items.title: AI Agents Are Moving Into the Real World
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude found a CRISPR-like enzyme system, Trump renames AI 'superintelligence' from the UN podium, and Altman and Amodei pitch the Security Council — but the main event is the evidence piling up that personal agents are real: Muse tops the App Store and jumps to glasses and a new always-on Charm device, while GrokBot moves into Teslas.

items.title: Quantum computing’s “dark horse” just proved it can go universal
items.summary: Researchers have shown that exotic quantum particles called non-Abelian anyons can perform the full range of operations needed for universal quantum computing. Using 54 qubits on Quantinuum’s H2 processor, they combined braiding and fusion to unlock capabilities that braiding alone could not provide.
